Qwen/Qwen3-4B.description: NeuroLink default. The model named in the "Basic usage (Open Source)" and "Streaming (Open Source)" examples of the vendor's OpenAI-compliant Chat Completions page (https://docs.bytez.com/http-reference/examples/openai-compliant/chatCompletionsExample.md, retrieved 2026-09-29), whose curl examples send it to POST https://api.bytez.com/models/v2/openai/v1/chat/completions, and the model in the Basic usage example of the chat Get started page (https://docs.bytez.com/model-api/docs/task/chat.md, retrieved 2026-09-29). Open models are billed per second of inference (How Credits Work table, https://docs.bytez.com/model-api/docs/billing.md). NeuroLink vision flag: false; the Chat Completions API reference (https://docs.bytez.com/http-reference/oaiCompliant/chatCompletions.md) types message content as string.

NeuroLink vision flag: false; the same reference types message content as string.

errorRules.message: Bytez answered HTTP 401 (an unauthenticated GET to the API returned the error "Unauthorized" on 2026-09-29; the Models API reference https://docs.bytez.com/http-reference/list/models.md describes 401 as "Auth error - check your api key and how you're sending it."). Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Get a key: {setupUrl}

Bytez reported insufficient credits (HTTP 402). The Billing & Credits page https://docs.bytez.com/model-api/docs/billing.md shows this response for an account whose credits ran out with auto-reload disabled: "Insufficient credits. Please add credits to continue."

Bytez rate limit (HTTP 429). The Models API reference https://docs.bytez.com/http-reference/list/models.md documents 429 as "Too Many Requests – You have hit the rate limit." and the Billing & Credits page https://docs.bytez.com/model-api/docs/billing.md says requests over the open model rate limits "are rejected with a rate-limit error".

instructions: 1. Open the API Dashboard at https://bytez.com/api; the Get started page (https://docs.bytez.com/model-api/docs/get-started.md) says "Copy your key from the API Dashboard"

2. Free plan (https://docs.bytez.com/model-api/docs/billing.md): "$0 / month - Get $1 in free credits", with "Run open models up to 7B parameters" and "Credits refresh every 4 weeks"; the Billing Cycle section lists Billing: None for the Free Plan
3. The same page lists a Pay-as-you-go plan with "Run open models up to 120B parameters" and "Add credits anytime"
setup.description: Docs-verified only: the vendor's GET https://api.bytez.com/models/v2/openai/v1/models needs a key (it answers HTTP 401 with the body {"error":"Unauthorized"} without one), so the two model ids come from the vendor's public docs (https://docs.bytez.com/http-reference/examples/openai-compliant/chatCompletionsExample.md and https://docs.bytez.com/http-reference/oaiCompliant/chatCompletions.md, retrieved 2026-09-29) and the roster has not been checked; the entry is not yet live-verified. OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.bytez.com/models/v2/openai/v1: the Chat Completions page's JavaScript and Python examples create an OpenAI client with that base URL and call chat.completions.create with a messages array, its curl examples POST to https://api.bytez.com/models/v2/openai/v1/chat/completions, and its streaming examples read event.choices[0].delta.content and finish_reason. The curl examples send the header Authorization: BYTEZ_KEY and the OpenAI client examples pass the key as apiKey; the Get started page (https://docs.bytez.com/model-api/docs/get-started.md) has the code comment # add an Authorization header, with value "Key {BYTEZ_KEY}" above a curl example that sends -H "Authorization: BYTEZ_KEY". The Chat Completions page examples send max_tokens, and the API reference lists max_completion_tokens (default 256). Closed-source provider models (for example openai/gpt-4) are addressed with a provider prefix and their curl examples add a provider-key header; this catalog has no field for an extra header, so none are listed. models.defaultContextWindow (8,192) and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens (1,024) are placeholders the vendor does not publish.
